diagnosis.cause: The historical report is authentic. Its input_members still carry two historical tool references whose exact successors are already authenticated elsewhere, but titleMeasurementCurrentSubject advances only inventory and native-handler metadata. titleMeasurementSourceReferences returns both tool references unchanged; inspectTitleSource.assertCurrent then compares physical current bytes to the old hashes.
diagnosis.second_latent_failure: scripts/canonical-tool-source-role.mjs would fail after only the first tool hash is repaired.

proposed_boundary.description: Use historicalContractRepairReaderSubject directly with physical root reads. For exactly scripts/dialog-title-source-context.mjs and scripts/canonical-tool-source-role.mjs, require one original input row, qualify that original reference, require a non-null successor, and verify predecessorReference(successor) is deeply identical to the original reference. Add those successor/original pairs to the existing references/previous maps. Invoke repairSubject.assertCurrent in the subject guard.
proposed_boundary.why_finite: The report supplies the immutable before references; the already-pinned reader manifest supplies and derives the exact after references by literal replay. No expected reference is calculated from candidate bytes, and no arbitrary repaired tool is selected.

cycle_review.direct_repair_reader_import: Static relative literal import/require traversal reaches five local files and does not reach inventory-reference-owner.mjs, dialog-title-source-context.mjs or canonical-tool-source-role.mjs. No new cycle was found through this direct import.
cycle_review.avoid: Do not invoke dialogTitleReaderSubject to qualify these two references. It enters canonical-tool-source-role.mjs, which imports the packed ledger owner, while the packed owner is already constructing the current title context.
cycle_review.self_binding: The repair reader validates inventory-reference-owner as bytes through the finite manifest. It does not execute that tool as part of the qualification; the guard therefore does not recursively call the title measurement helper.

guard_scope_caveat.observation: titleMeasurementSourceReferences returns an array of 95 references, not the subject guard. inspectTitleSource.assertCurrent rehashes that array. It catches later bytes changes to both newly advanced tool paths, but does not by itself retain guards for every transitive provenance input of repairSubject.
guard_scope_caveat.current_owner_protection: packed-upstream-ledger-epoch context already includes repairs.bound and repairs.assertCurrent in assertTools, covering late manifest and repaired-reader mutations during the real owner run.
guard_scope_caveat.recommendation: Test late target bytes at the source-helper boundary and late provenance at the outer epoch boundary. If the standalone source/native API is intended to own late provenance identity too, explicitly retain its subject guard there rather than claiming the existing 95-reference loop covers it.
